results.title: Diverse psychotropic substances detected in drug and drug administration equipment samples submitted to drug checking services in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, October 2019-April 2020

llm.inclusion_criteria: People who use drugs submitting drug samples or used drug administration equipment anonymously and free of charge to drug checking services in downtown Toronto
18 years of age or older, currently in the USA, used or consumed products containing delta-8-THC
llm.exclusion_criteria: Under 18 years of age, not currently in the USA, no prior use of delta-8-THC products

results.title: Psychedelic experience dose-dependently modulated by cannabis: results of a prospective online survey

llm.inclusion_criteria: At least 18 years old, good understanding of English language, intention to take a serotonergic psychedelic drug (psilocybin/magic mushrooms/truffles, LSD/1P-LSD, ayahuasca, DMT, 5-MeO-DMT, mescaline, 2C-B or others with similar mechanism of action)

results.title: Obesity risk is associated with altered cerebral glucose metabolism and decreased μ-opioid and CB1 receptor availability

llm.inclusion_criteria: High-risk group: male sex, age 20-35 years, BMI 25-30 kg/m2, leisure time physical exercise <4 h/week, maternal/paternal overweight or obesity or maternal/paternal T2D. Low-risk group: male sex, age 20-35 years, BMI 18.5-24.9 kg/m2, leisure time physical exercise ≥4 h/week, no maternal/paternal T2D.
llm.exclusion_criteria: Poor compliance with study schedule, smoking or use of nicotine products, abusive use of alcohol, use of illicit drugs, any chronic disease or medication affecting glucose metabolism or neurotransmission, neurological or psychiatric disease, eating disorder, contraindication to MRI, prior participation in PET studies or significant radiation exposure.

results.title: Endocannabinoid Levels in Ulcerative Colitis Patients Correlate With Clinical Parameters and Are Affected by Cannabis Consumption

llm.inclusion_criteria: UC patients aged 20-80 with mild to moderate UC diagnosed at least 3 months prior, Lichtiger score 4-15, Mayo endoscopic subscore ≥1; CD patients aged 20-80 with mild to moderate CD diagnosed at least 3 months prior, CDAI ≥200, SES-CD >2
llm.exclusion_criteria: Current cannabis use (medical or recreational), pregnancy or lactation, severe UC (Mayo score >10) or severe CD (CDAI >400), proctitis (inflammatory segment <15 cm), known psychiatric diagnosis, addiction traits, requirement for operation during study period

results.title: Cannabinoid receptor CNR1 expression and DNA methylation in human prefrontal cortex, hippocampus and caudate in brain development and schizophrenia

llm.inclusion_criteria: Postmortem human brain tissue with RNA integrity number ≥5; samples from DLPFC, hippocampus, and caudate; subjects spanning fetal period (gestational weeks 14-20) through age 85-86; diagnostic groups including schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, major depressive disorder, and non-psychiatric controls
llm.exclusion_criteria: Significant neuropathology including cerebrovascular accidents and neurodegenerative diseases; positive toxicology was exclusionary for control subjects but not for patients with psychiatric disorders

results.title: Cerebrospinal fluid endocannabinoid levels in Gilles de la Tourette syndrome

llm.inclusion_criteria: Adult patients with Tourette syndrome (TS) according to DSM-5, diagnosis confirmed by study author, able to undergo lumbar puncture without contraindications, cerebral MRI performed
llm.exclusion_criteria: Patients suffering from other severe psychiatric or neurological diseases (e.g., schizophrenia, alcoholism, epilepsy, mental retardation) or any kind of autoimmune disease

results.title: Schizophrenia and depression, two poles of endocannabinoid system deregulation

llm.inclusion_criteria: Postmortem prefrontal cortex samples from subjects with schizophrenia (n=24), depression (n=24), and normal controls (n=24); matched for age (±5 years), sex, race, side of brain, and postmortem interval
llm.exclusion_criteria: Control subjects with history of psychiatric disorders, antipsychotic or antidepressant medication use, death by suicide, or neurological disorder were excluded

results.title: Cerebrospinal fluid anandamide levels, cannabis use and psychotic-like symptoms

llm.inclusion_criteria: Cannabis users using >10 times/month (heavy) or <10 times/month (light); controls used cannabis fewer than 8 times in lifetime; all free from psychopathology or current medical problems per DSM-IV criteria
llm.exclusion_criteria: Any diagnosis of psychopathology or current medical problems per DSM-IV criteria

results.title: THC reduces the anticipatory nucleus accumbens response to reward in subjects with a nicotine addiction

llm.inclusion_criteria: Occasional cannabis users (at least 4 times/year, at most once/week) with no negative cannabis experiences; HC: FTND score of 0 and <0.5 cigarettes/day; NAD: FTND score ≥3 and ≥10 cigarettes/day
llm.exclusion_criteria: Personal or first-degree relative diagnosis of psychiatric disorder (assessed via MINI for DSM-IV); previous negative experiences with cannabis (bad trip or cannabis-induced psychosis); high blood pressure; movement artefacts during scanning; lack of elevated plasma THC levels; not fulfilling HC or NAD inclusion criteria
